wants.topic: Maa Durga Domestic Miracles & Bhakt Pariksha
wants.evidence: GuruVaani Studio's videos on Maa Durga doing household work for devotees achieved massive engagement (vsNormal up to 572.42 with 'माँ दुर्गा से आखिर क्यों बूढ़ी औरत ने करवाया खूब काम?'). Rasiya Films also performed strongly with Maa Durga and Adhaiya Brahman stories (vsNormal 10.47).

wants.topic: Debate & Defense of Sanatan Dharma Concepts
wants.evidence: Bk Usha Motivational scored massive hits addressing common skepticism, such as 'हिंदू धर्म में इतने भगवान और दूसरे धर्म में एक ही भगवान क्यों?' (vsNormal 110.94) and 'मक्का में शिवजी को कैद कर दिया है' (vsNormal 69.29).

wants.topic: Full Epic Story Compilation (Ramayana / Mahabharata Complete)
wants.evidence: Rasiya Films' 'Ramayana Full Movie | रामायण की पूरी कहानी एक ही फिल्म में' generated 30.37x normal views, showing high demand for complete mega-stories in one video.

wants.topic: Impossible Challenges & Swayamvar Stories (Moral AI Dramas)
wants.evidence: THE BH STORIES dominated with 'घमंडी राजकुमारी का स्वयंवर: 5 असंभव शर्तें' across multiple episodes (vsNormal 33.17, 15.89, 12.18).

gaps: Stories of lesser-known local bhakts and regional folk traditions (like Adhaiya Brahman) dramatized with emotional AI/3D storytelling.
Logical, scriptural explanations addressing popular misconceptions about Hindu deities without dry philosophical jargon.
Complete single-video epics narrating full Puranic leelas continuous from start to finish.
saturated: Standard day-by-day Navratri Vrat Kathas (e.g. Katyayani Katha / Mahishasura Vadh recitations scored standard vsNormal under 0.08).
Generic motivational shorts/reels disconnected from a story arc.
Basic repetitive horror/aghori mystery titles without emotional or devotional payoff.
